[[File:4NG-FF51.png|thumb|right|[[4/NG]] was the personal valet and majordomo to Grappa the Hutt]]
A '''valet''' was a being employed as a personal attendant. During her time as an [[Actor/Legends|actress]], [[Rollo Morsai]]&mdash;performing under the name Jona Reeten&mdash;employed a valet known as [[Tiebo]]. When Morsai opted for the life of a tramp [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] after being blacklisted, Tiebo was employed as her [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]].

[[4-LOM/Legends|4-LOM]] served as a valet aboard the [[Passenger liner/Legends|passenger liner]] ''[[Kuari Princess/Legends|Kuari Princess]]'' before turning to a life of crime as a [[Thief/Legends|thief]] and [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]].<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
